DETAIL PAGE INTRO
You start with a working support desk: a public page where customers submit a ticket, a portal where they follow the conversation, and a team side where agents reply and track every request. It suits any product or service that answers customer questions by message and wants each one kept on record until it is resolved.

DETAIL SECTIONS
## What you get
A public support page with a Submit a ticket button, plus log in, sign up, team sign up and password reset pages. Your team gets an Inbox of open and pending tickets, an All tickets list with search and filters, a ticket page with status, priority, assignee, replies and internal notes, a Customers list, and Settings for your company name, logo and welcome message. Customers get a dashboard with ticket counts and two charts, their own ticket list, a new ticket form and profile settings.

## Who it is for
Small software products that want customers to report problems in one place instead of scattered emails. Service businesses, such as agencies or repair shops, that want a record of every customer request and who is handling it. Clubs and member groups that take questions from members. It is not a live chat tool: conversations happen as ticket replies, not instant messages on your site.

## Making it yours
Most people start by setting their company name, logo and portal welcome message in Settings. From there, ask in chat to rename the ticket statuses and priorities to match how your team works, add a category or product field to the new ticket form, change the wording on the public support page, or add a page of answers to common questions.

HIGHLIGHTS
Customer portal with ticket history and charts
Shared team inbox with ticket assignees
Internal notes customers never see
Your company name, logo and welcome message

CAPABILITIES
Ticket search by subject, number or customer, with status and priority filters
Open, pending and resolved statuses with low, normal and high priority
A customer reply reopens a pending or resolved ticket
Customer list with ticket counts, last activity and each customer's tickets
Separate sign-in for customers and your team, with admin and agent roles

NOTES
- Title: the site's own name is "RiverX Helpdesk" (package name riverx-helpdesk); "RiverX" was dropped so the catalogue does not name RiverX itself. Change it if you prefer another name.
- Preview image and live preview URL were not given and are left empty.
- Password reset: the forgot and reset password pages exist, but no email is sent until an email provider is connected; the reset link is only logged on the server (and shown on the page in development). The content mentions the pages only, not reset emails.
- Security: the README notes that every admin and agent can read every table, internal notes included, through the app's own Data API (the dev proxy in the preview, `/api/db` when published), and that the preview shares the published app's database. "Internal notes customers never see" holds for customers, who only use `/api/portal/*`. Review before setting Live = Yes.
- Stores: customers, tickets, replies and internal notes, team members, helpdesk branding, and sign-in accounts and sessions.
- Description is 135 characters. Longest lines: capability "Ticket search by subject, number or customer, with status and priority filters" at 78/80; getting started step 2 at 97/110.
